$comment: Phrases in an effect rationale or its paired memory note that ASSERT a guard is absent, unbuilt or not blocking. Gate 0 fails on one only when the link's guard is in fact WIRED — the phrase alone is never a finding, because this repository narrates its own defects constantly and a word-matcher that flagged every 'not yet' would be deleted within a release. See F-089 and .harness/plans/F-089-a-rationale-that-describes-a-world-that-is-gone.md.
$patternComment: PRESENT TENSE ONLY. 'was red for two features' is narration and true; 'is not yet blocking' is a claim about now. The distinction is the whole design: keep the list short enough to read, and when it fires on legitimate narration remove the phrase rather than marking the prose.

claims.pattern: not yet blocking|is not blocking|does not block
claims.name: a guard that does not block
claims.why: E-017 said its guard was "built and proven but NOT YET BLOCKING" for three features after F-076 wired it into pnpm test:content. A reader deciding whether to skip a verification believes this sentence.

claims.name: a guard asserted absent
claims.why: The honest case is carried by the link's own `guard: "none"` field, which this check skips. Saying it in prose while the field names a wired guard is the two disagreeing.

claims.pattern: must (?:still )?be built|has yet to be (?:built|wired|written)|is not (?:yet )?wired
claims.name: a guard described as still owed
claims.why: An obligation that has been discharged and still reads as owed sends the next person to build something twice, or to trust a check they think is missing.

claims.pattern: exits 1 today|fails today because|cannot run today
claims.name: a present-tense claim that the guard cannot run
claims.why: E-017 said verify-font-coverage.mjs "exits 1 today because no font asset exists". F-076 shipped the asset. The word `today` is what makes this a claim about now rather than history.

$allowComment: A rationale may describe a past state on purpose — the narrative of a defect is often the most useful part of a note. Append `past-state-ok: <reason>` to the sentence. Visible in the prose a reviewer is already reading, for the same reason retired-ok is: an exemption in a config file nobody opens is an exemption nobody weighs.
